test_title: PYST 40: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follows the given statements.

**Statements :**

I. No Flower is Plant.

II. Some Animal are Flower.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some Animal are not Plant.

II. All Plant are Animal.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7621e1f93d8e238caada6310c1697cc98a31df792721f6eca69a7b1984521d0.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some Animal are not Plant → Follow (As no Flower is Plant and some Animal are Flower. As Bananas cannot be cherries which whole comes in litchis, therefore it is true.)

(II) All Plant are Animal → Does not follow (As no Flower is Plant and some Animal are Flower. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
